title: Switch terminal
intro: A terminal on one switch, with your own switch login. Each switch gets a tab; up to three stay open side by side.
noPlugin: No plugin that can open a switch terminal is on. An admin turns on SSH port actions under Settings > Plugins.
audited: Every line you type is in the audit log with your name. Lines typed at a password prompt are logged as hidden.
full_one: You can have {{count}} terminal open at a time. Close one first.
full_other: You can have {{count}} terminals open at a time. Close one first.
limits: Closes after {{idle}} minutes without typing, {{max}} minutes at most.
